junior.expectations: Explain component state and request flow, identify a user-visible failure, and propose a focused reproduction or test.

identify an async or stale-state failure and a reproducible check

intermediate.expectations: Reason about concurrency, cache ownership, rendering and recovery trade-offs; verify behavior under adversarial ordering.

explain request cancellation or stale-response prevention
